name: Swig Life 24 oz Party Cup Tumbler (Scrub Life)
seoTitle: Scrub Life Insulated Tumbler for Nurses
metaDescription: A Swig Life 24 oz insulated tumbler in the Scrub Life print with a slider lid. A cheerful gift for nurses who live on coffee through long shifts.
summary: An insulated 24 oz tumbler in a Scrub Life print, sized for the coffee that gets a nurse through report and beyond.
whyItWorks: Coffee on a nursing unit has a hard life. It gets poured before report, abandoned at the nurses station when a call light goes off, and rediscovered two hours later. An insulated tumbler with a lid gives that cup a fighting chance of still being warm, and the Scrub Life print makes it obvious whose cup it is in a crowded break room.

The 24 oz size is generous without being a jug, and the title notes it fits a cup holder, which matters for nurses who drink half of it on the drive in. A slider lid is also friendlier than a straw for hot drinks. As a gift, it feels like a treat rather than a necessity, which is exactly what you want for Nurses Week, a birthday, or a thank you to a nurse who cared for someone you love.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for dishwasher guidance on the cup and lid.
Some units do not allow drinks at the bedside, so it will likely live at the station or break room.
Pair it with a bag of good coffee for a complete gift.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a night shift nurse?
faq.a: Yes. Night shift often means coffee in waves, and an insulated tumbler keeps it drinkable through the slow stretch of the night.

faq.q: Can it hold cold drinks too?
faq.a: It is described as an insulated tumbler, so it should work for iced drinks as well. Check the listing for how long it holds temperature.
